meta.title: 不送髋=费腿费力｜会送髋=轻松提速
meta.title_en: No Hip Drive = Heavy Legs; Hip Drive = Easy Speed

scenes.context: 跑步要送髋，不送髋会怎样？后腿趋髋、下坐、脚后跟先着地，身体向前侵入，会造成膝关节和髋关节的运动损伤。
sentences: 跑步要送髋，不送髋会怎样？
You need hip drive when running—what happens if you don't?
hip drive（送髋）
后腿趋髋下坐，脚后跟先着地。
You sit back, load the rear hip, and heel-strike first.
heel-strike（脚跟着地）
身体向前侵入，会造成膝关节、髋关节的运动损伤。
Forward collapse like this leads to knee and hip overuse injuries.
overuse injury（运动损伤）
scenes.speak: You need hip drive when running—what happens if you don't? You sit back, load the rear hip, and heel-strike first. Forward collapse like this leads to knee and hip overuse injuries.

scenes.context: 跑动的时候什么叫送髋？跑的时候髋关节向前顶出去就叫送髋；不送髋就是髋没往前顶、腿在后面拖着。
sentences: 跑动的时候什么叫送髋？
What does hip drive actually mean while running?
hip drive（送髋）
跑的时候髋往前顶出去，这样就送髋。
Drive the hip forward as you run—that's sending it.
drive forward（向前顶）
这样就没送髋，这样就是送髋。
Like this—no drive. Like this—drive.
no drive（没送髋）
scenes.speak: What does hip drive actually mean while running? Drive the hip forward as you run—that's sending it. Like this—no drive. Like this—drive.

scenes.title_en: A Straight Line at Foot Strike
scenes.context: 跑的时候整体前倾，脚向前摆动落地的一瞬间，脚、髋、头要在一条竖直直线上，这样才算标准的送髋落地。
sentences: 跑的时候整体前倾。
Lean your whole body forward as you run.
lean forward（前倾）
脚向前摆动落地的一瞬间，脚、髋、头要在一条竖直直线。
At the moment of landing, foot, hip and head form one vertical line.
vertical line（竖直直线）
这样就送髋。
That's hip drive.
hip drive（送髋）
scenes.speak: Lean your whole body forward as you run. At the moment of landing, foot, hip and head form one vertical line. That's hip drive.

scenes.context: 跑动的时候，时刻感觉好像有人用手推着你的背往前走，这个意象能让身体自然进入前倾+送髋的节奏。
sentences: 跑动的时候，时刻感觉有人用手推着你的背往前走。
As you run, always feel like someone's hand is pushing your back forward.
push forward（向前推）
这个感觉能帮你自然送髋。
That cue naturally engages your hip drive.
cue（提示意象）
scenes.speak: As you run, always feel like someone's hand is pushing your back forward. That cue naturally engages your hip drive.

scenes.context: 结论：跑步送髋，跑出风速，省力一半。送髋让每一步都借到重心前移的势能，腿不再拖着跑。
sentences: 跑步送髋，跑出风速，省力一半。
Run with hip drive and you'll feel half as tired.
half as tired（省力一半）
髋往前送，腿就轻松了。
Drive the hip forward and your legs lighten up.
lighten up（变轻松）
scenes.speak: Run with hip drive and you'll feel half as tired. Drive the hip forward and your legs lighten up.

practice: Without hip drive, you sit back, heel-strike and risk knee injuries.
Drive the hip forward as you run—that's sending the hip.
At landing, foot, hip and head form one vertical line.
Feel like someone's hand is pushing your back forward.
Run with hip drive and you feel half as tired.
pitfalls: That loads the rear hip and heel-strikes—a recipe for injury.
Hip drive plus a forward lean is the whole picture.
The 'hand pushing your back' image does the work for you.
Forgetting the vertical line at landing.
Foot, hip and head aligned keeps the chain efficient.
shifts: 用 hip drive（送髋）、forward lean（前倾）、vertical line（竖直直线）
用 feel half as tired（省力一半）、lighten up（变轻松）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录口播（繁体字幕）。已校正：不送髋会造成后腿趋髋下坐、脚后跟先着地、身体向前侵入导致膝髋关节运动损伤、跑动时髋关节向前顶出去就是送髋、整体前倾落地瞬间脚髋头在一条竖直直线、时刻想象有人用手推着背往前走、跑步送髋跑出风速省力一半等。
